headline.knownPatchDeltaCoverageMeaning: Share of result-affecting fields with no outstanding published patch delta against them. Says nothing about whether the number itself is current.
headline.currentNumericalVerificationMeaning: Share of result-affecting fields whose value is either confirmed against the live version or affirmatively checked as unchanged through it. Carrying an old value forward on the absence of a delta does NOT count.
headline.doNotMerge: These two figures measure different things and must always be reported separately.

reasons: 6 of 62 weapons carry an unresolved published patch delta (see weaponOverrides). The other 56 are patch-reconciled with no known delta - which is NOT the same as numerically verified against 1.4.2.5: only 3 of 573 result-affecting fields have live-version or affirmative-unchanged evidence
